answers.goal: I want to direct, for sure. I love the ability to not only have creative control over the story but also to lead talent. I find it very enjoyable working through a scene as if I were in front of the camera and talking through the best way to portray the characters for that particular piece.
answers.drew: I know it's not everyone's first choice of a favorite movie, but it's mine because it's the film that got me into entertainment. The movie was released when I was in 7th grade, and it impacted me as a coming-of-age film. I realized Tom Holland's character just wanted to be heard and help others, and I wanted to do the same. Now, since that film created that impact for me, I want to do it for others.
answers.seeking: Definitely more on the scripted side, I come from an unscripted background, so I want to learn and discover more about narrative. However, I also want to share my documentary knowledge with people; having worked in two major unscripted companies, I think I have a lot to offer others about the space!
answers.inspiration: It's actually not a filmmaker; it's my dad. I really think he's the model of the person I want to be one day, with his work ethic and love for his job. Not only does he treat others with kindness, but he's compassionate and my best friend.
